description: This PHP source file defines the BufferStream class within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, implementing a stream interface that allows buffer management with reading, writing, and control functionalities.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: A class that implements a writable and readable buffer stream with high water mark features, supporting buffer writes, reads, and status checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BufferStream with an optional high water mark value, defaulting to 16384.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire buffer contents as a string.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer contents and clears the buffer.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and detaches the stream, returning null.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the current buffer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is readable (always true).

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is writable (always true).

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream cannot seek (always false).

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position (not supported) by calling seek(0).

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception because seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty, indicating end of stream.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws an exception because position tracking is unsupported.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length of data from the buffer, removing it from the buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer and returns false if the high water mark is exceeded.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the high water mark if requested, or other metadata if available.
